lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਰੋਸਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ekai bhaarosau ba(n)dhan kaatanahaar gur mero ||2||6||25||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have one article of faith; my Guru is the One who releases me from bondage. ||2||6||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਦਲੁ ਸੰਤਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਗਾਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai dal sa(n)tan tumhrai gaahio ||
lines.translation: Your Saints have overwhelmed the wicked army of corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree tek bharosaa thaakur saran tumhaaree aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They take Your Support and place their faith in You, O my Lord and Master; they seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਿਟਾਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke mahaa paraachhat darasan bhet mitaahio ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the terrible sins of countless lifetimes are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨਦ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio pragaas anad ujeeaaraa sahaj samaadh samaahio ||1||
lines.translation: I am illumined, enlightened and filled with ecstasy. I am intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun kahai tum te kachh naahee tum samarath athaahio ||
lines.translation: Who says that You cannot do everything? You are Infinitely All-powerful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa nidhaan ra(n)g roop ras naam naanak lai laahio ||2||7||26||
lines.translation: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning the Profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: boodat praanee har jap dheerai ||
lines.translation: The drowning mortal is comforted and consoled, meditating on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: binasai mohu bharam dukh peerai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is rid of emotional attachment, doubt, pain and suffering. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarau din rain gur ke charanaa ||
lines.translation: I meditate in remembrance, day and night, on the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jat kat pekhau tumaree saranaa ||1||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see Your Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t prasaad har ke gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur bhetat naanak sukh paaiaa ||2||8||27||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has found peace. ||2||8||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat naam manahi sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, peace of mind is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh janaa mil har jas gaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Holy Saint, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੇਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh ridai basero ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, God has come to dwell within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan sa(n)tan kai maathaa mero ||1||
lines.translation: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham kau simarahu manaa(n) ||
lines.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Supreme Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naanak har jas sunaa(n) ||2||9||28||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak listens to the Praises of the Lord. ||2||9||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man preet charan prabh parasan ||
lines.translation: My mind loves to touch the Feet of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ਅਖੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa har har bhojan tripataanee akheean kau sa(n)tokh prabh darasan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My tongue is satisfied with the Food of the Lord, Har, Har. My eyes are contented with the Blessed Vision of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਮਲ ਹਰਸਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanan poor rahio jas preetam kalamal dokh sagal mal harasan ||
lines.translation: My ears are filled with the Praise of my Beloved; all my foul sins and faults are erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਧਾਵਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਸਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paavan dhaavan suaamee sukh pa(n)thaa a(n)g sa(n)g kaaiaa sa(n)t sarasan ||1||
lines.translation: My feet follow the Path of Peace to my Lord and Master; my body and limbs joyfully blossom forth in the Society of the Saints. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਸਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran gahee pooran abinaasee aan upaav thakit nahee karasan ||
lines.translation: I have taken Sanctuary in my Perfect, Eternal, Imperishable Lord. I do not bother trying anything else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi leee naanak jan apane a(n)dh ghor saagar nahee marasan ||2||10||29||
lines.translation: Taking them by the hand, O Nanak, God saves His humble servants; they shall not perish in the deep, dark world-ocean. ||2||10||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਕਤ ਕਪਟ ਖਪਟ ਖਲ ਗਰਜਤ ਮਰਜਤ ਮੀਚੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuhakat kapat khapat khal garajat marajat meech anik bareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those fools who bellow with rage and destructive deceit, are crushed and killed innumerable times. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰ ਮਤ ਅਨ ਰਤ ਕੁਮਿਤ ਹਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੇਖਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਲਾਖ ਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n) mat an rat kumit hit preetam pekhat bhramat laakh gareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: Intoxicated with egotism and imbued with other tastes, I am in love with my evil enemies. My Beloved watches over me as I wander through thousands of incarnations. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਨਤ ਮਮ ਮਦ ਮਾਤ ਕੋਪ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anit biuhaar achaar bidh heenat mam mad maat kop jareeaa ||
lines.translation: My dealings are false, and my lifestyle is chaotic. Intoxicated with the wine of emotion, I am burning in the fire of anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: karun kripaal goupaal deen ba(n)dh naanak udhar saran pareeaa ||2||11||30||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord of the World, Embodiment of Compassion, Relative of the meek and the poor, please save Nanak; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||11||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaanaRaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan maan daataa ||
lines.translation: The Giver of the soul, the breath of life and honor

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisarate hee haan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: - forgetting the Lord, all is lost. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਾਗਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d tiaag aan laagahi a(n)mrito daar bhoom paagahi ||
lines.translation: You have forsaken the Lord of the Universe, and become attached to another - you are throwing away the Ambrosial Nectar, to take dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਸਿਉ ਆਸਕਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bikhai ras siu aasakat mooRe kaahe sukh maan ||1||
lines.translation: What do you expect from corrupt pleasures? You fool! What makes you think that they will bring peace? ||1||
